truths.truth: /cad-adopt run in a git repo with no .planning/ writes PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, ROADMAP.md, STATE.md and config.json, and /cad-health reports zero problems
truths.evidence: All five writes are present as workflow steps and the seams they call exist: cadence-core/workflows/adopt.md:38-45 (mkdir .planning, `planning.mjs trace ignore --root .`, verbatim templates/config.json copy, config.mjs get), :134-156 write_project, :158-176 write_requirements, :178-210 write_roadmap, :212-224 `planning.mjs cursor set --phase 1`. Backing seams exist: planning.mjs:2243 (`sub === 'ignore'`), planning.mjs:2101 TRACE_IGNORE_LINE. `node cadence-core/bin/self-verify.mjs` -> {"ok":true,...,"problems":[]} includes the invocations/paths checks over adopt.md. Health-rule falsifiers are explicitly guarded in prose (rule 5 at :183-187, rule 7 at :149-155). No run has been executed, so zero-problem /cad-health is unobserved.

truths.truth: The adopted .planning/ carries remaining work only: no - [x] phase, bare Traceability headers, Active version not in git tag --list, cursor at phase 1
truths.evidence: Each of the four is a stated rule with its falsifier named: adopt.md:183-187 (every ## Phases entry is `- [ ]`, /cad-health rule 5 cited), :170-175 (## Traceability left as BARE HEADERS, seed-reqs no-phase-dir/no-plans cited), :149-155 (Active version is a PROPOSED NEXT version, never the repo's current tag, /cad-health rule 7 cited), :216-219 (`cursor set --phase 1`). Also restated in success_criteria :290-294. Nothing computes or enforces them at runtime, so only a walked run settles them.

truths.truth: Adopt's questioning asks only what the repo cannot answer, with no scored or checklist-driven suppression
truths.evidence: The `questioning` step exists and is substantive: adopt.md:82-132. The suppression rule is stated as judgment with the naming test ("a question is legitimate only when it names something the repo does not state", :89-92), the four-item checklist is marked "mental, never a conversation structure" (:94-95), and :125-131 forbids score, coverage percentage, threshold, rubric and per-item walk (D-06). `grep -nE 'score|threshold|rubric|percent' cadence-core/workflows/adopt.md` matches only that prohibition block. Whether a real run actually suppresses the three answered topics is behavior no probe here can exercise.
